target: Roblox 2021-era R6; Pekora/Caelus runtime not supplied
executorRequired: HTTP GET via request/http_request/syn.request or game:HttpGet
dataBackend: typed JSON, Instance.new, exact stored keyframe CFrames; companion .rbxmx is an archival/import format
meshBackend: writable MeshPart if supported; otherwise same original MeshId/TextureID in SpecialMesh scaled with stored InitialSize
knownLimits: Roblox-hosted content payloads and permissions were not available for in-engine verification.
MeshPart-to-SpecialMesh cannot reproduce PBR SurfaceAppearance; this is an explicit fidelity limit.
Highlight flashes are unavailable on clients without Highlight; remaining source particles still load.
Unavailable UIStroke/UIFlexItem properties are reported; older clients may differ in borders/layout.
No alternative UnionOperation geometry is generated; CSG is retained in server map XML only.
source animation clock models the old per-frame player at nominal 60 Hz; exact frame-rate-dependent bugs are not reproduced.
Modern properties in the original map need actual target-engine import testing.
Built-in chat emotes retain original Roblox AnimationIds; hosted availability and their rendered timing require a target-runtime test.
Each chat dance request uses one server-selected original variant for consistent presentation on other clients; the original Animate selected locally.
